problem_type: Viewport menu anchors inherit a transformed containing block
symptom: Node effect More menu appears 507px away from the trigger in Electron.
direct_cause: WorkbenchMenu portals Content but leaves its fixed Trigger under the canvas transform.
class_root: Viewport point coordinates require both the anchor and popup to live outside transformed ancestors.
affected_population: Point menus mounted under CSS transform, including canvas node composers

external_sources.purpose: Portals move DOM while preserving React context and events.

invariants: Viewport menu anchors are mounted directly under document.body regardless of their React owner.
generality_proof: The shared menu places both trigger and content in body portals; callers cannot reintroduce a transformed containing block via their ancestry.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Keep point anchor and popup in the viewport coordinate space.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real Electron default transform caused 507px offset; browser walk also adds an ancestor translation.
Uses the same WorkbenchMenu point API and now the same body anchor.
Lab projects the real anchor DOMRect to viewport coordinates instead of passing local coordinates; four existing PNG baselines are retained.

recurrence.reason: Any new point menu nested under transform would reproduce the coordinate error.
same_class_scan: Read src/design/menu.tsx: Trigger outside Portal, Content inside Portal.
rg WorkbenchMenu found canvas NodeContextMenu and timeline TimelineContextMenu sharing the point boundary.

prevention.invariant: Point coordinates are interpreted relative to the viewport.
prevention.failure_mode: The anchor cannot inherit any caller transform because its DOM parent is document.body.
prevention.strategy: Portal the virtual trigger at the existing shared menu boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: The in-tree virtual Trigger is replaced, with no alternate coordinate implementation.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: React createPortal and the installed Radix menu already support this; Nomi mounted its virtual Trigger at the wrong DOM boundary.

migration: No data migration. Existing point-menu props and behavior remain.
residual_risks: OS-native context menus are outside this React DOM boundary.
